lines.en: My blue wings cut the light
One beat and I have turned
I climb along a vine bridge
I pass through a patch of sun
I swing round a broad leaf
I glide through the warm air
I spiral close to a trunk
I make for red blooms in the grove
I fly above the undergrowth
I rise and dip among shadows
I angle down into the flowers
I keep beating steadily on
I fly low over moss
I ride a shaft of light upward
I slip through a gap in the leaves
I round a hanging vine
I rest on a vine
My blue wings are folded
I rest under a leaf
My wings fan slowly
I wait for a warm current
The light in the grove is broken
My antennae point up
I listen to water drip
Fine lines cross my wings
I take one slow sip
I crouch at a flower's heart
I gather my six feet in
I circled above your head
Your head moved too sharply
My blue flashes before you
You carry no flowers
I settle on the branch beside you

lines.zh: 你指缝里有花粉的味道
lines.en: There's pollen scent between your fingers
You have come near my blooms
You are stepping on fallen leaves
I lift a little higher

lines.zh: 你挡住了我想吸的那朵
lines.en: You're blocking the bloom I wanted
I lose some height
My wing is knocked askew
I pause on a leaf
A small patch of scales is gone
My wingbeats come hard
My antennae fold down
I fly crooked for a while
Wings still joined, I can still rise
I steady myself and rise
That slowed me down
That is the red of a poppy
I smell nectar on it
You lift the flower up
I circle it twice
I land on the petal's edge
This one is open just right
I ease my proboscis in
It is sweet, very good
I let you hold it still
I want one more sip
You caught my wing edge
The bump sends me off line
I turn over once in the air
I lift clear of you
My scales rub onto you
I hurry to find a perch
You have blocked the airflow
I skim off your hat
My blue wing only tilts
I start beating my wings again
That blue beyond is one of mine
We fly for the same flowers
He flies higher than I do
We cross paths in the air
We circle the same tree
I follow his shadow
There is a little more blue here
We settle on one flower together
We touch only at the wingtips
We fly off side by side
I settle on the thing
It has no nectar smell
I prod it with my feet
This is no part of a flower
I lift off and circle once
I land on the flower beside it
My wing brushed it

lines.zh: 我的口器碰了碰就收了
lines.en: My proboscis touches it and withdraws
I return to the flower's heart
I remember this place
I have spotted a patch of red
My wings turn that way
There is nectar that way
I beat my wings faster
I drop low and fly over
That bloom is brighter than the rest
I change my flight line
I mean to push that leaf aside

lines.zh: 那朵虞美人在风里点头
lines.en: That poppy nods in the wind
I angle that way
I narrow my wings and sink slowly
The petal bends under me
I am choosing where to set down
I stretch my legs out
I am very near the flower's heart
The wind suddenly dies
I fold my wings and drop
That bloom is a little too high
I climb a foot higher
This is the one I wanted
My wings beat your face
I hit your knuckle
I burst upward to break free
My wing tip rakes your hand
I beat again and again
I swerve past your ear
The flower in your hand sways
One swipe and I am off
This time I did not dodge
And I fly back to the bloom
A fleck of blue drops into the blooms
I slip out between the vines
My wings turn blue in the light
A blue butterfly joins the grove
I beat my wings and rise

lines.zh: 我落在高处的一朵花上
lines.en: I settle on a high bloom
The warm air lifts me
I come around the vines
My shadow lands on a leaf
I fly toward the light
Flame licks my wing's edge
I land on a leaf and spin
Water soaks through my wings
The blast pushes me far
An arrow shears a corner off my wing
Magic scrambles my colors
The flowers are empty and I am weak
A flash leaves my wing tips numb
I keep falling
